achievement--lhResult--msg:
# Now we are getting to know you even better

You've logged a positive ovulation test, congratulations! A positive ovulation test detects a surge in luteinising hormone and can give the algorithm a helping hand when confirming ovulation and getting to know your unique cycles.

On top of a positive test, the algorithm needs to detect a sufficient rise in temperature to confirm that ovulation happened—so please keep measuring!
auth-disclaimer-oura2: While your goal might be to use the app to prevent a pregnancy, please beware that Natural Cycles is only certified as a birth control in Europe and the US in combination with the use of a basal thermometer. In combination with the Oura ring, Natural Cycles is only available as beta version and solely intended for use as a fertility tracker.

info-dataFlag--TEMP_EXTRACTION_DISCARDED: You’ll see Not enough data if there isn’t enough temperature and/or heart rate data available from WHOOP. This can happen if: - You didn’t wear your device while you slept - The device wasn’t properly positioned - The device didn’t have enough battery In these cases, the NC° Fertility Algorithm won’t take that night’s data into account when calculating your fertility status. It’s worth noting that WHOOP and NC° process data differently. Sleep metrics may vary between apps and devices.
info-health-data-analyse:
To calculate your fertility status our algorithm will analyse the following:

* Temperature
* Period
* Spotting (bleeding that is not a menstrual period)
* Ovulation test results
info-health-data-body:
The Natural Cycles app will inform you when and if you are fertile based on the data you add to it. If you use the app to track a pregnancy, the app will provide you with information about the pregnancy. It follows from the nature of our services that we must process such data that you add to the services to enable and provide them. Below we have listed some examples of sensitive data that we need for this purpose. For more detailed information on our processing of your personal data, please see our privacy policy.

To calculate your fertility status

Our algorithm will calculate your fertility status based on an analysis of the health data that you provide, such as temperature, menstruation and ovulation test results.

To provide pregnancy information

If you are tracking a pregnancy, our app will provide information about the pregnancy based on the health data that you add, such as pregnancy test results.

To determine the App’s Pearl Index

Intercourse data is collected and displayed for our users’ convenience, but it is also an important piece of information when determining our overall Pearl Index rate (a calculation used to estimate the effectiveness of birth control).
info-health-data-pregtest-body: Natural Cycles will use pregnancy test results to analyse your cycle and calculate your pregnancy status.
info-stis-body:
Sexually transmitted infections, commonly called STIs, are diseases that are spread by having sex with someone who has an STI.

Natural Cycles does not protect against sexually transmitted infections. Use a condom to protect against STIs.
info-typical-use-body: The Typical Use Pearl Index of a contraceptive method estimates how many women (out of 100) will become pregnant during one year.
integration-benefits-body--WHOOP_BAND: By connecting your WHOOP account with the NC° app, you’re enabling us to import key data. Please note that this data sharing is one way and no data from your NC° account is shared back to WHOOP. Importing data from WHOOP To integrate with your wearable, you’ll be asked to allow access to the following data: - Cycles - Profile - Recovery - Sleep Why is this data required? The imported data includes temperature and heart rate data. The NC° app uses it to calculate your fertility status and detect changes so we can adjust for your lifestyle. Allowing access ensures that NC° can process all the essential metrics to provide a reliable fertility status and other insights.

msg-error-txt: Oh no, an error has occurred. Please try the following: close the app and reopen it again. If the error still remains, check in your app store that you have the latest version of the app installed. If you are still having problems, please contact our support team and include your registered Natural Cycles email as a reference. Thanks!
my-data-lh-tests-txt:
An ovulation test helps the algorithm find your ovulation, but it is not required. Think of it as extra credit! 

The test is a stick that analyses your urine for the Luteinising Hormone (LH), which surges right before ovulation. A positive ovulation test does not confirm ovulation, but it helps the algorithm's calculations.
